entities.name: Attach Procedure
entities.description: The EPS attach procedure performed by the UE to register with the network.

entities.name: Detach Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to detach the UE from the network, either initiated by UE or network.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message sent by network to accept attach request.

entities.name: ATTACH COMPLETE
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to complete attach procedure.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message to initiate detach procedure.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: EMM state where UE has initiated registration but not yet completed.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH
entities.description: EMM state where UE is attempting to attach after previous failures.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: EMM state where no suitable cell is available.

entities.name: Timer T3411
entities.description: Timer started when attach attempt counter is less than 5.

entities.name: Timer T3402
entities.description: Timer started when attach attempt counter reaches 5.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer started when extended wait time is received from lower layers.

entities.name: Attach Attempt Counter
entities.description: Counter tracking number of attach attempts, with maximum value of 5.

entities.name: Access Barring Condition
entities.description: Condition where access is barred for originating signalling due to access class barring, EAB, ACDC.

entities.name: Lower Layer Failure Condition
entities.description: Condition where RRC connection establishment fails or NAS signalling connection is released.

entities.name: Extended Wait Time Condition
entities.description: Condition where extended wait time is received from lower layers.

relations.description: Access barring prevents starting of attach procedure.
Lower layer failure causes attach procedure to be aborted.
Extended wait time from lower layers starts timer T3346.
Timer T3346 running prevents starting of attach procedure except in specific cases.
Attach procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.
Attach procedure includes sending ATTACH REQUEST message.
Attach procedure includes receiving ATTACH ACCEPT message.
Attach procedure includes sending ATTACH COMPLETE message.
Detach procedure includes sending DETACH REQUEST message.
When attach attempt counter reaches 5, timer T3402 is started.
When attach attempt counter is less than 5, timer T3411 is started.
When timer T3411 expires, attach procedure is restarted.
When timer T3346 expires, attach procedure is started if still necessary.
Receiving DETACH REQUEST message in certain conditions causes attach procedure to be aborted.
After attach procedure abortion, UE changes to EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH state.
After S101 mode to S1 mode handover cancellation, UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
